text: ライバルの　おまえが　よわいと　はりあい　ないからな！

structure.jp: ライバルの　おまえが　よわいと
structure.en: if you, my rival, are weak

structure.jp: はりあい　ないからな！
structure.en: there's no point competing, after all!

patterns.name: 〜と (if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain statement means 'if' or 'whenever', with the result following naturally. よわいと = 'if you're weak'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement means 'because'. Here it ends the sentence, giving the reason for what he just said. ないからな = 'because there'd be none, you know'.

patterns.name: 〜の (apposition)
patterns.span: ライバルの　おまえ
patterns.explanation: Here の does not mean 'of': both sides are the same person. ライバルの　おまえ = 'you, my rival'.
